parameters.query:
=SELECT DISTINCT ON (ni.id) ni.id, ni.news_key, ni.title, ni.url, ni.source, ni.published_at, na.betroffene_ticker_json
FROM trading.news_items ni
JOIN trading.news_assessments na ON na.news_id = ni.id
WHERE na.wirkungsebene = 'unklar'
  AND na.prompt_version <> 'news-recherche-agent-v1'
  AND ni.status = 'evaluated'
ORDER BY ni.id, na.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
SELECT ticker, name, sektor, aliases_json, exclude_patterns_json, benchmark_symbol FROM trading.stock_instruments WHERE aktiv = TRUE ORDER BY sortierung;

=SELECT ni.title, na.wirkungsrichtung, na.created_at
FROM trading.news_assessments na
JOIN trading.news_items ni ON ni.id = na.news_id
WHERE na.betroffene_ticker_json @> {{ JSON.stringify($('Nur echte Kandidaten weiterreichen').item.json.betroffene_ticker_json || []) }}::jsonb
  AND na.betroffene_ticker_json <> '[]'::jsonb
ORDER BY na.created_at DESC LIMIT 10;
